import { Badge } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

Every workspace stores its data in exactly one region, chosen when the workspace is created.

| Region | Location | Identifier |
| ------ | -------- | ---------- |
| Europe | Frankfurt | `eu` |
| United States | Ohio[^us-preview] | `us` <Badge text="Preview" variant="caution" /> |

Submissions, attachments and exports never leave the region. Device health signals are processed in the same region.

## Choosing a Region

Pick the region closest to where your **data** has to live, not where your team is. A device in the field talks to the region's API over HTTPS from anywhere.

## Moving a Workspace <Badge text="Not supported" variant="danger" />

A workspace cannot change region. To move, create a workspace in the new region, re-register devices, and import surveys with `fieldkit surveys import`.

[^us-preview]: Preview workspaces carry the same guarantees as Europe except the uptime commitment, which starts at general availability.
